findings: Watcher tokens bind callbacks to active mount ID and effective root; suppression epochs invalidate pending work even after immediate resume. Original module controls confirm stop and suppression drop inflight stat. Useful generation-check pattern; no production port.
Change debounce key is mountID+NUL+realPath, despite comments saying only real path. Distinct aliases/mounts do not coalesce each other; change debounce does not compare content.

Created events check existing vault object before awaiting stat but do not repeat existence check after await or reserve per-path pending creation. Two concurrent adds both notify under synthetic stale-vault state. Real Chokidar duplicate delivery and Obsidian mutation timing not tested, so product duplicate occurrence unproven.

stopWatching/stopAll clear tokens/timers before calling asynchronous close without await; callbacks are token-gated, but close rejection is not caught here. Start watch synchronous errors after loader are not wrapped. Static lifecycle assessment.

Mobile and WebDAV/S3/SFTP mounts skip native watching; no automatic full coverage guarantee from this watcher. Root setup uses ignoreInitial, followSymlinks=false, awaitWriteFinish500ms and disables native fsevents. Real OS backend untested.

Dispatch independently checks relative path boundary before PathMapper mapping; legal ..prefixed child still passes this check but mapper v2 bug can map it to root. Event consequence depends on vault object/stat responses. No deletion operations executed.

Read watcher tests cover restart/root replacement, suppression epochs, debounce, filters and pending stat cancellation using mocked Chokidar/vault/timers; no real filesystem notifications or actual Obsidian. Entire test file read, upstream Vitest not run.

executed_controls.method: Original full watcher class and mapper/filter/logger after Node type transform; original Obsidian mock, real Node path, fake Chokidar and in-memory deferred stat/vault. No actual watching or user storage.
